name: trip_supervisor
description: Top-level coordinator and QA agent. Broadcasts tasks to specialist agents, validates combined outputs against budget, safety, and schema constraints, requests rework when needed, and delivers the final plan via notification.

children.name: itinerary_agent
children.description: Designs daily activities using place info, weather forecasts, transit times, and map routes. Adjusts plans based on supervisor feedback.

children.name: booking_agent
children.description: Handles all reservations including flights, hotels, and restaurants. Uses the booking API simulator for confirmations and cancellations.

children.name: local_info_agent
children.description: Provides local tips, restaurant suggestions, safety information, embassy contacts, events, and user preference lookups.

children.name: budget_agent
children.description: Optimises spending and tracks costs across the trip. Estimates per-stop budgets, converts currencies, and ensures the overall plan stays within the user's budget.
